review_candidates.description: Who We Are Looking For State Street is looking for an M365 Exchange & Security Engineer to become part of our Collaboration Services team in Boston. Why this role is important to us The role will help deliver the Collaboration Services roadmap, modernize mail flow and threat-protection capabilities, strengthen operational resilience and provide support for business and technical users of these services. Working with the tower lead, architects, engineers, operations teams and key control partners, the engineer will be responsible for requirements gathering, solution engineering, implementation, documentation and advanced support across Exchange and email security. What You Will Be Responsible For As the Collaboration Services M365 Exchange & Security Engineer you will Engineer, configure and support Exchange Online, Exchange hybrid and remaining on-premises Exchange services, including mail flow, transport rules, connectors, accepted domains, certificates, TLS, message routing, RBAC and service integrations. Engineer and support Microsoft Defender for Office 365 and third-party email security services, including anti-phishing, anti-spam, anti-malware, Safe Links, Safe Attachments, quarantine and threat investigation. Design, test and implement roadmap changes such as Exchange Server Subscription Edition lifecycle work, mailbox and public-folder migrations, cloud mail-flow modernization, legacy platform decommissioning and retirement of technical debt. Provide advanced engineering support for production issues involving mail flow, message tracing, delivery failures, permissions, authentication, certificates, encryption, service health and Microsoft 365 interoperability. Support secure onboarding of applications and platforms to Exchange services, including SMTP relay, connectors, service principals, APIs and approved automation accounts. Support email encryption and data-protection capabilities, including Microsoft Purview Message Encryption, RMS behaviour, external recipient experience and integration with third-party email security and DLP platforms. Provide advanced support during major incidents, lead technical troubleshooting, engage Microsoft and other vendors, identify root cause and document corrective and preventive actions. Develop and maintain PowerShell and Microsoft Graph automation for repeatable engineering, administration, reporting, validation, monitoring and support activities. Design and maintain least-privilege administrative access using Microsoft 365 RBAC and enterprise identity-governance processes. Create and maintain solution designs, technical standards, implementation plans, test plans, operational procedures, recovery procedures, support documentation and user guidance. Prepare for and participate in audit activities, provide technical evidence and remediate control or documentation gaps. Monitor Microsoft product changes and roadmap announcements, assess service impact and convert relevant changes into planned engineering or operational work. Identify opportunities to reduce technical debt, simplify the service estate and improve operational processes through standardisation and automation. Provide knowledge transfer and technical guidance to engineering and operations teams, and support controlled handover of new capabilities into production. What We Value These skills will help you succeed in this role Deep hands-on engineering and support experience with Exchange Online and Exchange hybrid or on-premises environments, including transport, connectors, mail routing, certificates, TLS, RBAC, mailbox management and troubleshooting. Strong experience with Microsoft Defender for Office 365 and enterprise email security controls, including threat policies, investigation, quarantine and mail-flow protection. Experience designing and supporting integrations between Exchange, Microsoft Purview, Microsoft Defender for Office 365 and third-party email security, DLP, archive or encryption platforms. Strong PowerShell skills for Exchange Online and Microsoft 365 engineering and administration; experience with Microsoft Graph, APIs, Power Automate or Python is beneficial. Practical knowledge of Microsoft Entra ID, authentication, Conditional Access, enterprise applications, service principals, privileged access and least-privilege design. Working knowledge of Microsoft Purview capabilities relevant to email, including Message Encryption, sensitivity labels, DLP, retention, eDiscovery and Audit. Experience with Microsoft 365 security and compliance controls in a large, regulated enterprise, including audit evidence, control testing, change management and risk remediation. Ability to troubleshoot complex end-to-end issues across cloud services, hybrid infrastructure, identity, networking, DNS, certificates and third-party integrations. Experience with service monitoring, incident management, problem management, change implementation, testing and operational readiness. Ability to work independently, lead technical workstreams and collaborate effectively with engineers, operations teams, control partners and vendors. Detailed and organised critical thinker with strong problem-solving skills and a focus on service resilience, security and supportability. Effective verbal and written communication skills, including the ability to explain technical risks, options and recommendations clearly. Education And Preferred Qualifications A degree in Computer Science (or a related discipline) or 5 or more years of equivalent work experience. Experience with Exchange Online, Microsoft Defender and Microsoft Purview Salary Range $90,000 - $157,500 Annual The range quoted above applies to the role in the primary location specified. If the candidate would ultimately work outside of the primary location above, the applicable range could differ. Employees are eligible to participate in State Street’s comprehensive benefits program, which includes: our retirement savings plan (401K) with company match; insurance coverage including basic life, medical, dental, vision, long-term disability, and other optional additional coverages; paid-time off including vacation, sick leave, short term disability, and family care responsibilities; access to our Employee Assistance Program; incentive compensation including eligibility for annual performance-based awards (excluding certain sales roles subject to sales incentive plans); and, eligibility for certain tax advantaged savings plans. For a full overview, visit https://hrportal.ehr.com/statestreet/Home . About State Street Across the globe, institutional investors rely on us to help them manage risk, respond to challenges, and drive performance and profitability. We keep our clients at the heart of everything we do, and smart, engaged employees are essential to our continued success. We are committed to fostering an environment where every employee feels valued and empowered to reach their full potential. As an essential partner in our shared success, you’ll benefit from inclusive development opportunities, flexible work-life support, paid volunteer days, and vibrant employee networks that keep you connected to what matters most. Join us in shaping the future. review_candidates.description: Job Title: Azure Systems Engineer Location: Tampa, FL or Los Angeles, CA (Candidates must currently reside in Tampa, FL or Los Angeles, CA). Working Mode: 3 days/week Hybrid Job Summary We are looking for an experienced Lead Corporate Systems Engineer to manage, improve, and support enterprise applications and corporate systems across Azure and on-premises environments. The ideal candidate will combine technical leadership with recent hands-on engineering experience. This role focuses on cloud infrastructure, automation, scripting, troubleshooting, and using AI to improve internal applications, corporate systems, and business processes. Key Responsibilities Design, maintain, and optimize enterprise applications and infrastructure across Azure and on-premises environments. Identify opportunities to implement AI, machine learning, and intelligent automation to improve business processes and internal applications. Translate business requirements into technical solutions using cloud services, automation, and modern engineering tools. Lead technical projects from requirements gathering and design through implementation. Troubleshoot complex system issues, perform root cause analysis, and implement solutions. Maintain system security, access controls, and compliance with standards such as PCI DSS and SOC 2. Develop automation solutions using scripting and Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tools. Monitor system performance using observability, logging, and monitoring tools. Collaborate with business and technical teams to improve corporate applications and workflows. Provide technical guidance and mentorship to other engineers while remaining hands-on with engineering tasks. Required Qualifications 5+ years of experience in Systems Engineering, Infrastructure Engineering, or a related technical role. Strong hands-on experience with Microsoft Azure and hybrid-cloud environments. Experience administering Windows and/or Linux servers. Knowledge of Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tools such as Terraform, Ansible, or ARM templates. Strong scripting skills in PowerShell, Python, and/or Bash. Hands-on experience with containers and observability tools such as Datadog, Prometheus, or the ELK stack. Experience or strong practical knowledge of using AI and intelligent automation to improve business processes, enterprise applications, or internal workflows. Ability to lead technical initiatives while remaining hands-on with implementation, troubleshooting, and engineering. Experience supporting enterprise applications in a regulated environment. Preferred Qualifications Experience in banking, financial services, fintech, or payments. Knowledge of PCI DSS, SOC 2, identity and access management (IAM), and enterprise security practices. Experience with Azure AI Services, large language models (LLMs), intelligent chatbots, or AI-powered workflow automation. C# development experience. Experience supporting back-office and corporate business systems.
